#### Time-to-Event Analysis using the drcte package that does a permutation statistical test. 
##### Based off and including example scripts from Onofri A, Mesgaran MB, Ritz C (2022) A unified framework for the analysis of germination, emergence, and other time-to- event data in weed science. Weed Sci. 70: 259–271. doi: 10.1017/wsc.2022.8

##### TO DECIDE = Currently using Non-Parametric function - then using the permutation test. There are parametric functions but I am not sure which to fit. Unsure about all their assumptions
#####  doesn't seem to matter when I run it parametric for root Ploidy - 

```{r}
Turion_dat<- read.csv('Turion_Data_Long.csv', header=T)

# Filter only valid genos, removing SP.00007, SP.00011, & SP.00041
Turion_dat <- Turion_dat %>% 
  filter(Geno %in% c("SP.00001.10","SP.00001.26","SP.00005.05","SP.00005.17","SP.00043.06","SP.00043.19"))

# renaming columns
colnames(Turion_dat)[10]<- 'DayBef'
Turion_dat$DayData<- Turion_dat$DayBef

Turion_dat$DayBef<- Turion_dat$DayBef-1

# cleaning up info columns and add adiitional combinations
Turion_dat$Geno<- gsub('.000', '-', Turion_dat$Geno) # just get the lineage
Turion_dat$Lineage<- gsub('\\..*', '', Turion_dat$Geno)  # remove sublineage code (anything after the .)

Turion_dat$Box_Epp <- paste(Turion_dat$Box., Turion_dat$EppLocation, sep="_") 
Turion_dat$LinPloid<- paste(Turion_dat$Lineage, Turion_dat$Ploidy, sep='_')

# then I am combining the 7-9 replicates from each epp
# Groups Box_Epp of 8 (for each stage separately)

Turion_dat_epp <- Turion_dat %>%
  group_by(Year, Geno, Lineage, Ploidy,LinPloid, Box_Epp, Stage, DayBef, DayData) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(freq = length(DayData))

Turion_dat_epp<- as.data.frame(Turion_dat_epp)

#
Turion_dat_epp$Treat_Box<- paste(Turion_dat_epp$LinPloid, Turion_dat_epp$Box_Epp,sep='-')
Turion_dat_epp$Treat_Stage<- paste(Turion_dat_epp$LinPloid, Turion_dat_epp$Stage,sep='-')
Turion_dat_epp$Ploid_Stage<- paste(Turion_dat_epp$Ploidy, Turion_dat_epp$Stage,sep='-')
Turion_dat_epp$Lin_PloidStage<- paste(Turion_dat_epp$Lineage ,Turion_dat_epp$Ploid_Stage,sep='-')
Turion_dat_epp$Year_PloidStage<-paste(Turion_dat_epp$Year, Turion_dat_epp$Ploid_Stage,sep=':')
Turion_dat_epp$Year_Lin_PloidStage<-paste(Turion_dat_epp$Year, Turion_dat_epp$Lineage, Turion_dat_epp$Ploid_Stage,sep='_')
Turion_dat_epp$Year_Ploid<- paste(Turion_dat_epp$Year, Turion_dat_epp$Ploidy,sep='-')

Turion_dat_epp <- Turion_dat_epp %>%
  mutate(DayBef  = as.numeric(as.character(DayBef)),DayData = as.numeric(as.character(DayData)))
```

```{r}
#Power Analysis - LOW POWER
#Pretty sure I am approaching this right, but the 100% germination seems to be influencing the results
#Minimum detectable hazard ratio (Schoenfeld 1983; Freedman 1982)
alpha_l <- 0.05
power_l <- 0.80
n_per_lineage <- 40
D_l <- 2 * n_per_lineage       # total events (100% germination)
psi_l <- 1/4                   # equal group sizes

MDHR <- exp((qnorm(1 - alpha_l/2) + qnorm(power_l)) / sqrt(D_l * psi_l))
MDHR
# WE CAN ONLY DETECT LARGE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN LINEAGES (>87% FASTER GERMINATION BETWEEN LINEAGES)

alpha_p <- 0.05
power_p <- 0.80
n_per_ploidy <- 120
D_p <- 2 * n_per_ploidy       # total events (100% germination)
psi_p <- 1/4                   # equal group sizes

MDHR_p <- exp((qnorm(1 - alpha_p/2) + qnorm(power_p)) / sqrt(D_p * psi_p))
MDHR_p
#WE CAN DETECT MORE MODERATE DIFFERENCES BETWEEN PLOIDY BUT STILL REQUIRES A PLOIDY TO GERMINATE 44% FASTER THAN OTHER 
```


```{r}
## graphing all 3 stages by Ploidy_Stage and Year

all <- drmte(freq ~ DayBef + DayData,curveid = Year_PloidStage,fct = NPMLE(),data = Turion_dat_epp)

plot(all)

obs_df <- plotData(all)
obs_df <- obs_df$plotPoints
obs_df$Time <- obs_df$DayData

nd <- Turion_dat_epp %>%
  distinct(Year_PloidStage, DayData) %>%
  transmute(Time = as.numeric(DayData), Year_PloidStage)

# Predict CDF for each curve at those times
pred_df <- predict(
  all,
  newdata    = nd,           
  interval   = TRUE,         
  level      = 0.95,
  npmle.type = "right")

pred_df<-pred_df[,-3]

curve_meta <- Turion_dat_epp %>%
  distinct(Year_PloidStage, Year, Ploidy, Stage)

all_data  <- pred_df

zeros <- all_data %>%
  distinct(Year_PloidStage) %>%
  mutate(Time = 0,Prediction = 0,Lower= 0,Upper= 0)

all_data <- bind_rows(all_data, zeros)
all_data  <- all_data %>% left_join(obs_df, by = c("Year_PloidStage","Time"))
all_data <- all_data %>% left_join(curve_meta, by = "Year_PloidStage")

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(DayData = ifelse(is.na(DayData), Time, DayData),CDF = ifelse(is.na(CDF), Prediction, CDF)) 

all_data <- dplyr::select(all_data, -plotid)

all_data<- all_data[!duplicated(all_data), ]

rm(zeros)
```

```{r}
# I think I am doing my planned contrasts correctly here and throughout
# Test whether Ploidy:Stage changed between 2025 and 2026

# Year-to-year comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("2025:2X-Float", "2026:2X-Float"),
  c("2025:2X-Frond", "2026:2X-Frond"),
  c("2025:2X-Root",  "2026:2X-Root"),
  c("2025:4X-Float", "2026:4X-Float"),
  c("2025:4X-Frond", "2026:4X-Frond"),
  c("2025:4X-Root",  "2026:4X-Root")
)

results <- data.frame(
  Comparison = character(),
  N1 = integer(),
  N2 = integer(),
  T_value = numeric(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (pr in comparisons) {

  testdat <- subset(
    Turion_dat_epp,
    Year_PloidStage %in% pr
  )

  fit <- drmte(
    freq ~ DayBef + DayData,
    curveid = Year_PloidStage,
    fct = NPMLE(),
    data = testdat
  )

  tst <- compCDF(
    fit,
    scores = "wmw",
    B = 10000
  )

  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      Comparison = paste(pr[1], "vs", pr[2]),
      N1 = tst$N[1],
      N2 = tst$N[2],
      T_value = round(tst$val0, 3),
      P_value = tst$pvalb
    )
  )
}

results$P_value <- format(results$P_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3)

print(results, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Create quantile/synchrony table
# Convert rownames into columns
qtab <- qmat %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Curve")

# Extract identifiers
qtab <- qtab %>%
  separate(
    Curve,
    into = c("Group", "Prob"),
    sep = "\\.(?=[0-9]+%)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Prob = paste0("T", gsub("%", "", Prob))
  )

# Keep median estimate
qtab <- qtab %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, Prob, Median, Lower, Upper)

# Convert to wide format
quant_summary <- qtab %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, Prob, Median) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Prob,
    values_from = Median
  )

# Split treatment names
quant_summary <- quant_summary %>%
  separate(
    Group,
    into = c("Year","Ploidy","Stage"),
    sep = "[:\\-]"
  )

# Synchrony metrics
quant_summary <- quant_summary %>%
  mutate(
    T90_T10 = T90 - T10,
    T75_T25 = T75 - T25
  )

quant_summary
#readr::write_csv(quant_summary, "quant_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
# Global lineage tests - DID THESE BUT SINCE WE ARE SHOWING THE PAIRWISE I DIDN'T MENTION IT
# Tests whether any of the three lineages differ within each
# Year × Stage × Ploidy combination

combos <- unique(
  Turion_dat_epp[c("Year", "Stage", "Ploidy")]
)

global_lineage <- list()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {

  yr <- combos$Year[i]
  st <- combos$Stage[i]
  pl <- combos$Ploidy[i]

  d <- subset(
    Turion_dat_epp,
    Year == yr &
    Stage == st &
    Ploidy == pl
  )

  d <- droplevels(as.data.frame(d))

  # Skip if fewer than 2 lineages remain
  if(length(unique(d$Lineage)) < 2) {
    cat(
      "\nSkipping:",
      yr, st, pl,
      "- only",
      length(unique(d$Lineage)),
      "lineage present\n"
    )
    next
  }

  cat(
    "\nRunning:",
    yr, st, pl,
    "| Lineages =",
    paste(sort(unique(d$Lineage)), collapse = ", "),
    "\n"
  )

  fit <- try(
    drmte(
      freq ~ DayBef + DayData,
      curveid = Lineage,
      fct = NPMLE(),
      data = d,
      control = drmteControl(conCheck = FALSE)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if(inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    cat(
      "Model failed for:",
      yr, st, pl, "\n"
    )
    next
  }

  tst <- try(
    compCDF(
      fit,
      scores = "wmw",
      B = 10000
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )

  if(inherits(tst, "try-error")) {
    cat(
      "Comparison failed for:",
      yr, st, pl, "\n"
    )
    next
  }

  global_lineage[[length(global_lineage) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Year = yr,
    Stage = st,
    Ploidy = pl,
    N_Lineages = length(unique(d$Lineage)),
    Test_Statistic = tst$val0,
    P_value = tst$pvalb
  )
}

global_lineage <- do.call(rbind, global_lineage)

global_lineage <- global_lineage %>%
  mutate(
    P_adj = p.adjust(P_value, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_value)

print(global_lineage, row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
# Testing whether lineages varied from each other within Year:Stage:Ploidy
combos <- unique(
  Turion_dat_epp[c("Year","Stage","Ploidy")]
)

results_lin <- list()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {

  yr <- combos$Year[i]
  st <- combos$Stage[i]
  pl <- combos$Ploidy[i]

  d <- subset(
    Turion_dat_epp,
    Year == yr &
      Stage == st &
      Ploidy == pl
  )

  lin_pairs <- combn(unique(d$Lineage), 2, simplify = FALSE)

  for(pr in lin_pairs) {

    dd <- droplevels(subset(d, Lineage %in% pr))

    if(length(unique(dd$Lineage)) < 2) next

    fit <- try(
      drmte(
        freq ~ DayBef + DayData,
        curveid = Lineage,
        fct = NPMLE(),
        data = dd,
        control = drmteControl(conCheck = FALSE)
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    if(inherits(fit, "try-error")) next

    tst <- compCDF(fit, scores = "wmw", B = 10000)

    results_lin[[length(results_lin) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Year = yr,
      Stage = st,
      Ploidy = pl,
      Comparison = paste(pr, collapse = " vs "),
      N1 = tst$N[1],
      N2 = tst$N[2],
      T_value = round(tst$val0, 3),
      P_value = tst$pvalb
    )
  }
}

results_lin <- do.call(rbind, results_lin)

results_lin <- results_lin %>%
  group_by(Year, Stage, Ploidy) %>%
  mutate(
    P_adj = p.adjust(P_value, method = "holm")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

results_lin <- results_lin[order(
  results_lin$Year,
  results_lin$Stage,
  results_lin$Ploidy,
  results_lin$P_value
), ]

print(results_lin, row.names = FALSE)
#readr::write_csv(results_lin, "results_lin.csv")
```

```{r}
t50_lineage <- t50_ci2 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ploidy,
    values_from = c(T50, Lower, Upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_T50   = T50_2X - T50_4X,
    Delta_Lower = Lower_2X - Upper_4X,
    Delta_Upper = Upper_2X - Lower_4X
  )

t50_lineage

plot_lineage <- t50_lineage %>%
  mutate(
    Group = toupper(Stage),
    Row = paste0(Lineage, " (", Year, ")")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Group,
    Row,
    Year,
    Delta_T50,
    Delta_Lower,
    Delta_Upper
  )

plot_global <- t50_ci %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Ploidy,
    values_from = c(T50, Lower, Upper)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_T50   = T50_2X - T50_4X,
    Delta_Lower = Lower_2X - Upper_4X,
    Delta_Upper = Upper_2X - Lower_4X,
    Group = "GLOBAL",
    Row = Stage
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Group,
    Row,
    Year,
    Delta_T50,
    Delta_Lower,
    Delta_Upper
  )

plot_dat_ci <- bind_rows(
  plot_global,
  plot_lineage
)

plot_dat_ci$color<-NA
plot_dat_ci$color[plot_dat_ci$Row %in% c("Float", "Frond", "Root")] <- 'black'
plot_dat_ci$color[plot_dat_ci$Row %in% c("SP-01 (2025)", "SP-01 (2026)")] <- '#5B8C5A'
plot_dat_ci$color[plot_dat_ci$Row %in% c("SP-05 (2025)", "SP-05 (2026)")] <- '#8C6BB1'
plot_dat_ci$color[plot_dat_ci$Row %in% c("SP-43 (2025)", "SP-43 (2026)")] <- '#B50D60'

plot_dat_ci$Row[plot_dat_ci$Group == "GLOBAL"] <-
  paste0(
    plot_dat_ci$Row[plot_dat_ci$Group == "GLOBAL"],
    " (",
    plot_dat_ci$Year[plot_dat_ci$Group == "GLOBAL"],
    ")"
  )

plot_dat_ci$Row <- factor(
  plot_dat_ci$Row,
  levels = rev(c(
    "SP-01 (2025)","SP-01 (2026)","SP-05 (2025)", "SP-05 (2026)","SP-43 (2025)","SP-43 (2026)",
    "Float (2025)", "Float (2026)", "Root (2025)", "Root (2026)","Frond (2025)", "Frond (2026)")))

plot_dat_ci$Group <- factor(
  plot_dat_ci$Group,
  levels = c(
    "GLOBAL",
    "FLOAT",
    "ROOT",
    "FROND"
  )
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_dat_ci, aes(x = Delta_T50, y = Row)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Delta_Lower, xmax = Delta_Upper), color = "black", height = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_dat_ci, Group == "GLOBAL"),aes(shape = Year, color = color), size = 4) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_dat_ci, Group != "GLOBAL"),aes(shape = Year, color = color), size = 3.25) +
  facet_grid(Group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("2025" = 16, "2026" = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Difference in median event time (days)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),panel.grid.minor =element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom", plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 5, 15),plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```
